name: ClickSyncr Form Sync for Benchmark Email – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms & More
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr Form Sync for Benchmark Email connects your forms to Benchmark Email, so every form submission becomes a contact on your Benchmark Email list: automatically, with no code.

Which Benchmark accounts. This release connects classic Benchmark Email accounts, the ones created before April 2026 whose API key comes from Integrations > API. Accounts on Benchmark’s new platform use a different key (it starts with bme_) and a different API; support for them is on its way, and the key card tells you when you paste one.

Works with your form builder

  • Contact Form 7
  • WPForms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator

One plugin, one Benchmark Email connection. ClickSyncr configures each form right inside the builder you already use, and it connects your forms to 20+ other email marketing platforms too.

“Benchmark Email” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Benchmark Email.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes: paste your Benchmark Email API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your lists load automatically: choose which Benchmark Email list new contacts join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map any field: send names, phone numbers, company, address and the other Benchmark Email contact fields straight from your form.
  • Built-in opt-in: add a consent checkbox and a ticked box syncs the visitor to your list while an unticked one sends nothing to Benchmark Email at all.
  • Honest about opt-in: Benchmark Email applies whatever opt-in your list is set to, and the panel says so instead of pretending to override it.
  • A setup for every form: each form can sync to a different Benchmark Email list with its own field mapping, in every supported builder.
  • Sync health at a glance: an admin-bar menu shows every form’s sync counts and the last error, if any, and Contact Form 7’s Status box shows it beside Save.
  • Help when something breaks: an Advanced card on every form offers a private debug log, a copyable system report, a one-click refresh of your lists and fields, and auto-update.
  • Lightweight and fast: built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control: you decide exactly what data is sent to Benchmark Email, and to which list.

Learn more about the forms to Benchmark Email integration.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 6.7 or higher
  • At least one supported form builder: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, or Forminator
  • A classic Benchmark Email account (created before April 2026) with an API key

Getting your Benchmark Email API key

  1. Log in to your Benchmark Email account.
  2. Open Integrations > API (or go straight to Benchmark Email → Integrations).
  3. Copy your API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Benchmark Email settings of any form.

Support

Need a hand? Browse the documentation, check the frequently asked questions, or contact us and we’ll be glad to help.

Benchmark Email

Connected forms send their submissions to Benchmark Email. Read more at Benchmark Email.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr Form Sync for Benchmark Email”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Edit any form and open its ClickSyncr Benchmark Email settings.
  2. Paste your Benchmark Email API key, choose a list, and map your fields (email is required).
  3. Save. Every submission now syncs to Benchmark Email automatically. Full guidance lives on the ClickSyncr Form Sync for Benchmark Email page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Benchmark Email account?

Yes. You’ll need an active classic Benchmark Email account and its API key to sync your contacts.

My key starts with bme_ and will not connect

That key belongs to Benchmark’s new platform, launched in April 2026, which speaks a different API. This release connects classic accounts; new-platform support is on its way, and the key card names the key for what it is the moment you paste it.

Which form builders are supported?

Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator. At least one of them must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Benchmark Email API key?

Log in to Benchmark Email and open Integrations > API, then copy your key. The setup guide shows exactly where to paste it.

Can I map custom fields?

Yes. Map any form field to Benchmark Email’s contact fields, from first and last name through phone, company and address.

How does the opt-in consent field work?

Pick a consent field (a checkbox, acceptance, or radio) from your form. When a visitor ticks it, the contact is sent to your list; when they leave it unticked, nothing is sent to Benchmark Email at all. Leave it as “None” to send every submission.

Does it work with Benchmark Email double opt-in?

Yes. Benchmark Email applies whatever opt-in your list is set to, single or double, and offers no way to override it per submission. The panel shows the list’s setting and links you to where it is changed.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every form has its own ClickSyncr Benchmark Email setup, so each can sync to a different list.

ClickSyncr Form Sync for Benchmark Email Privacy

The plugin sends only the fields you map, and only to Benchmark Email. Nothing is collected by ClickSyncr itself. Read about our policy.
